about.en: almost exactly; on the subject of

according.en: according to: as said or shown by

account.ex: Her account of the accident was very clear.

acrimonious.ex: The two partners went through an acrimonious split.
acrimonious.zh: 尖刻的；激烈而充滿敵意的

affordability.en: whether something can be paid for
affordability.ex: The council is studying the affordability of new homes.
affordability.hi: वहनीयता; ख़र्च उठा पाने की क्षमता
affordability.ja: 費用負担が可能かどうか
affordability.zh: 可負擔性；能否負擔得起

affordable.ex: We need more affordable housing in the city.

alarm.ex: The news caused alarm among parents.

an.en: one; used before a vowel sound

angry.ex: The customers were angry about the delay.

any.en: every or one of a group, no matter which
any.zh: 任何（any similar hospital：任何同類醫院）

approached.ex: The children got excited as the holidays approached.

approval.ex: The plan still needs approval from the council.

approximately.ex: The trip takes approximately two hours.

arguing.en: giving reasons to show something is true
arguing.ex: He is arguing that the tax is unfair.
arguing.hi: तर्क देते हुए; दावा करते हुए

argument.ex: My neighbours had a loud argument last night.

around.ex: The repair will cost around 200 euros.
around.zh: 大約；（Around the same period：大約同一時期）

as.en: while; at the same time that; in the role of
as.zh: 當…時；隨著；（recorded as saying：被記錄為說）

asserted.en: stated firmly that something is true
asserted.ex: The lawyer asserted that her client was innocent.

example.en: The minister asserted that the plan would save money.
example.zh: 部長斷言該計畫會省錢。

note.meaning: 斷言；堅定地聲稱某事屬實。
note.usage: assert that + 子句；也可 assert one's rights/authority（維護權利）。

noteEn.meaning: to say firmly that something is true.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ministro afirmó que el plan ahorraría dinero.
noteEs.meaning: afirmar con firmeza que algo es verdad.
noteEs.usage: assert that + oración; también assert one's rights.

noteHi.exampleTr: मंत्री ने ज़ोर देकर कहा कि योजना से पैसे बचेंगे।
noteHi.meaning: दृढ़ता से कहना कि कोई बात सच है।
noteHi.usage: assert that + वाक्य; assert one's rights भी प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 大臣はその計画で費用が節約できると断言した。
noteJa.meaning: あることが真実だと強く述べる；断言する。
noteJa.usage: assert that＋節；assert one's rights（権利を主張する）もある。

noteKo.exampleTr: 장관은 그 계획이 돈을 절약할 것이라고 단언했다.
noteKo.usage: assert that + 절; assert one's rights(권리를 주장하다)도 쓴다.

at.en: in or near a place or state

authority.en: an official organisation that controls an area
authority.ex: The local authority closed the road for repairs.

bare.en: lay bare: show clearly something hidden
bare.ex: The report laid bare the city's money problems.
bare.ja: lay bare：暴露する；明るみに出す
bare.zh: lay bare：揭露；使赤裸裸呈現

because.en: because of: as a result of

become.ex: The weather became cold in the evening.

been.zh: be 的過去分詞（had been building：一直在累積）

big.ex: They have a big problem with the car.

biggest.ex: This is the biggest park in town.

board.en: a group of people who manage an organisation
board.ex: The board will vote on the plan next week.

bosses.en: people in charge of other workers
bosses.ex: My boss let me leave work early today.

budget.ex: We have a small budget for the party.

building.ex: Pressure had been building for weeks before the strike.
building.ja: 高まっていた；積み重なっていた

buildings.ja: ガバメント・ビルディングズ（アイルランド政府庁舎）
buildings.zh: Government Buildings：政府大樓（愛爾蘭總理府所在）

busiest.ex: Friday is the busiest day at the shop.

by.en: showing who does something; how much
by.zh: 被；由；（by some margin：以明顯差距）

came.en: came to a head: reached a crisis point
came.es: came to a head: llegó a su punto crítico
came.ex: Things came to a head when the boss shouted at everyone.
came.hi: came to a head: चरम पर पहुँच गया
came.ja: came to a head：頂点に達した；表面化した
came.ko: came to a head: 정점에 달했다
came.zh: came to a head：（矛盾）達到頂點；爆發

capacity.en: the amount that can be handled
capacity.ex: The stadium has a capacity of 50,000 people.

capture.ex: The photo captures the joy of the moment.

care.ex: Elderly people need good medical care.

categorically.ex: The company categorically denied the rumours.
categorically.ja: 断固として；きっぱりと

causing.ex: The storm is causing delays on the roads.

cautioned.ex: The doctor cautioned him against eating too much salt.

checked.ex: She checked if the shop was open.

chief.ex: She is the chief engineer on the project.
chief.ja: 最高の（chief executive：最高経営責任者）
chief.zh: 首席的（chief executive：執行長；院長）

claimed.en: said something is true without proof
claimed.ex: He claimed he had never seen the letter.

communicated.ex: We communicated mainly by email last year.
communicated.ja: 連絡を取った；意思疎通した

comparable.ex: Prices here are comparable to those in the capital.

concern.ex: There is growing concern about air pollution.

conditions.ex: Working conditions in the factory have improved.

conduct.ex: The team will conduct a survey next month.

conflict.ex: The conflict between the two teams lasted for years.

consequently.ex: He missed the bus and consequently arrived late.

considerable.en: large or important enough to notice
considerable.ex: The repairs cost a considerable amount of money.

consultant.ex: The consultant explained the test results to my mother.
consultant.zh: 主治醫師；顧問醫師（英愛的資深專科醫師）

contended.ex: The scientist contended that the data was wrong.

contends.ex: He contends that the rules are unfair.

contentious.ex: Taxes remain a contentious issue in the election.
contentious.ja: 論争を呼ぶ；対立の激しい

example.en: Building the new road is a highly contentious issue.
example.zh: 興建新道路是極具爭議的議題。

note.meaning: 有爭議的；容易引發激烈爭論的。
note.usage: 多修飾 issue/dispute/debate/decision；比 controversial 更正式。

noteEs.exampleTr: Construir la nueva carretera es un tema muy polémico.
noteEs.meaning: que provoca mucha discusión o desacuerdo.
noteEs.usage: Suele acompañar a issue/dispute/debate; más formal que controversial.

noteHi.exampleTr: नई सड़क बनाना एक बेहद विवादास्पद मुद्दा है।
noteHi.meaning: जिस पर बहुत असहमति हो; विवादास्पद।
noteHi.usage: अक्सर issue/dispute/debate के साथ; controversial से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい道路の建設は非常に論争の的となっている問題だ。
noteJa.meaning: 論争や対立を引き起こしやすい。
noteJa.usage: issue/dispute/debate などを修飾；controversial より改まった語。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 도로 건설은 매우 논란이 많은 문제다.
noteKo.usage: 주로 issue/dispute/debate를 수식; controversial보다 격식 있는 말.

contingent.ex: The deal is contingent on bank approval.

example.en: Your job offer is contingent on a health check.
example.zh: 你的錄用要視健康檢查結果而定。

note.usage: 固定搭配 contingent on/upon sth；常用於正式文件與合約。

noteEn.meaning: depending on something else happening first.

noteEs.exampleTr: Tu oferta de trabajo depende de un examen médico.
noteEs.meaning: que depende de otra cosa; condicionado.
noteEs.usage: Siempre contingent on/upon algo; frecuente en textos formales.

noteHi.exampleTr: आपकी नौकरी का प्रस्ताव स्वास्थ्य जाँच पर निर्भर है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी और बात पर निर्भर; शर्त पर आधारित।
noteHi.usage: हमेशा contingent on/upon sth; औपचारिक लेखन में आम।

noteJa.exampleTr: あなたの採用は健康診断の結果次第だ。
noteJa.meaning: ほかの事柄次第の；〜を条件とする。
noteJa.usage: contingent on/upon＋名詞 の形で使う；正式な文書に多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 당신의 채용 제안은 건강 검진 결과에 달려 있다.
noteKo.meaning: 다른 일에 달려 있는; ~을 조건으로 하는.
noteKo.usage: 항상 contingent on/upon + 명사; 격식 있는 문서에서 흔하다.

continuing.ex: Prices are continuing to rise this year.

conversations.ex: We had a long conversation about our plans.

cork.en: a city in the south of Ireland
cork.ja: コーク（アイルランドの都市）

correspondence.en: letters and emails sent between people
correspondence.ex: All correspondence should be sent to the main office.
correspondence.ja: 書簡；やり取りした文書

country.en: a nation with its own government
country.ex: Canada is a very large country.

curbs.ex: The city introduced curbs on car use.

day.ex: The shop is closed for the day.

deficit.en: money spent beyond what is available
deficit.ex: The club ended the season with a large deficit.

example.en: The city is trying to reduce its budget deficit.
example.zh: 該市正努力減少預算赤字。

note.meaning: 赤字；支出超過收入或預算的差額。
note.usage: 常見 face/run/incur a deficit；budget deficit；a deficit of + 金額。

noteEn.meaning: the amount by which spending is more than income or budget.
noteEn.usage: Common: "face a deficit", "budget deficit", "a deficit of €X".

noteEs.exampleTr: La ciudad intenta reducir su déficit presupuestario.
noteEs.meaning: diferencia cuando el gasto supera los ingresos o el presupuesto.
noteEs.usage: Se usa face/run a deficit, budget deficit, a deficit of + cantidad.

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर अपने बजट घाटे को कम करने की कोशिश कर रहा है।
noteHi.meaning: ख़र्च आय या बजट से ज़्यादा होने का अंतर; घाटा।
noteHi.usage: face/run a deficit, budget deficit, a deficit of + राशि आम प्रयोग हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 市は予算の赤字を減らそうとしている。
noteJa.meaning: 支出が収入や予算を上回る差額；赤字。
noteJa.usage: face/run a deficit、budget deficit、a deficit of＋金額 の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 시는 예산 적자를 줄이려고 노력하고 있다.
noteKo.meaning: 지출이 수입이나 예산을 넘는 차액; 적자.
noteKo.usage: face/run a deficit, budget deficit, a deficit of + 금액 형태가 흔하다.

demand.ex: Demand for fresh fruit rises in summer.

denied.ex: The player denied breaking the rules.

deteriorate.ex: Old photos deteriorate if kept in the sun.

example.en: My grandfather's health deteriorated over the winter.
example.zh: 我祖父的健康在冬天期間惡化了。

note.usage: 主詞常為 health/conditions/relations/situation；continue to deteriorate；deteriorate rapidly。

noteEs.exampleTr: La salud de mi abuelo empeoró durante el invierno.
noteEs.usage: El sujeto suele ser health/conditions/relations; continue to deteriorate.

noteHi.exampleTr: सर्दियों में मेरे दादाजी की सेहत बिगड़ गई।
noteHi.usage: कर्ता प्रायः health/conditions/relations; continue to deteriorate आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 祖父の健康は冬の間に悪化した。
noteJa.meaning: だんだん悪くなる；悪化する。
noteJa.usage: 主語は health/conditions/relations など；continue to deteriorate の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: 주어로 health/conditions/relations가 흔하다; continue to deteriorate.

deteriorating.ex: His eyesight has been deteriorating for years.

example.en: My grandfather's health deteriorated over the winter.
example.zh: 我祖父的健康在冬天期間惡化了。

note.usage: 主詞常為 health/conditions/relations/situation；continue to deteriorate；deteriorate rapidly。

noteEs.exampleTr: La salud de mi abuelo empeoró durante el invierno.
noteEs.usage: El sujeto suele ser health/conditions/relations; continue to deteriorate.

noteHi.exampleTr: सर्दियों में मेरे दादाजी की सेहत बिगड़ गई।
noteHi.usage: कर्ता प्रायः health/conditions/relations; continue to deteriorate आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 祖父の健康は冬の間に悪化した。
noteJa.meaning: だんだん悪くなる；悪化する。
noteJa.usage: 主語は health/conditions/relations など；continue to deteriorate の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: 주어로 health/conditions/relations가 흔하다; continue to deteriorate.

diabetes.en: an illness with too much sugar in the blood
diabetes.ex: Regular exercise can lower the risk of diabetes.

direct.ex: She gave me a direct answer to my question.

disclosed.ex: The company disclosed its profits on Monday.
disclosed.ja: 公開された；開示された

discussion.ex: The class had a lively discussion about climate.

dispatched.ex: The shop dispatched my order this morning.

dispute.ex: The workers are in a dispute over pay.

doctor.en: a person trained to treat sick people
doctor.ex: I need to see a doctor about my back.

document.ex: The film documents life in a small village.

documents.ex: Please sign these documents before you leave.

earlier.en: at a time before now or then

early.en: near the beginning of a period

employees.en: people paid to work for an organisation

equivalent.en: equal in size, value or type
equivalent.ex: A mile is roughly equivalent to 1.6 kilometres.

escalated.ex: The protest escalated after the police arrived.
escalated.ja: 激化した；エスカレートした

example.en: The argument quickly escalated into a fight.
example.zh: 那場爭吵很快升級成打架。

note.meaning: （衝突、問題）升級、加劇、變得更嚴重。
note.usage: 常見 a conflict/dispute escalates；escalate into + 更糟的情況；不及物用法最常見。

noteEn.meaning: to become more serious or intense.
noteEn.usage: Common: "a dispute escalated", "escalate into a crisis".

noteEs.exampleTr: La discusión pronto se convirtió en una pelea.
noteEs.meaning: un conflicto o problema se agrava o se intensifica.
noteEs.usage: Se usa a conflict escalates; escalate into + algo peor.

noteHi.exampleTr: बहस जल्दी ही लड़ाई में बदल गई।
noteHi.meaning: टकराव या समस्या का और गंभीर हो जाना।
noteHi.usage: a conflict escalates; escalate into + बदतर स्थिति आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 口論はすぐにけんかへとエスカレートした。
noteJa.meaning: 対立や問題がより深刻になる；激化する。
noteJa.usage: a conflict escalates、escalate into＋より悪い状態 の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: a conflict escalates, escalate into + 더 나쁜 상황 형태가 흔하다.

exceeding.ex: The cost is exceeding our budget.

exchange.ex: There was a short exchange between the two drivers.

executive.ex: She became a senior executive at a bank.
executive.zh: 主管；執行長（chief executive）；行政（executive officer）

executives.ex: The two executives met for lunch.

expects.ex: The shop expects to sell more toys in December.

expenditure.en: money spent, especially by an organisation
expenditure.ex: Government expenditure on schools has gone up.

example.en: The school must reduce its expenditure on energy.
example.zh: 學校必須減少能源方面的支出。

note.meaning: 支出；（政府或機構的）開支總額。
note.usage: 比 spending 更正式；public/government expenditure；expenditure on sth。

noteEn.meaning: money spent, especially by a government or organisation.

noteEs.exampleTr: La escuela debe reducir su gasto en energía.
noteEs.meaning: dinero que gasta una organización o un gobierno.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que spending; public expenditure; expenditure on algo.

noteHi.exampleTr: स्कूल को ऊर्जा पर अपना व्यय घटाना होगा।
noteHi.meaning: संस्था या सरकार द्वारा ख़र्च की गई राशि; व्यय।
noteHi.usage: spending से अधिक औपचारिक; public expenditure, expenditure on sth।

noteJa.exampleTr: 学校はエネルギーへの支出を減らさなければならない。
noteJa.meaning: 組織や政府が使うお金；支出。
noteJa.usage: spending より改まった語；public expenditure、expenditure on＋名詞。

noteKo.usage: spending보다 격식 있는 말; public expenditure, expenditure on + 명사.

face.en: to have to deal with something bad
face.ex: The company may face a large fine.

facility.en: a building or place for a service
facility.ex: The new sports facility opens in May.

facing.en: having to deal with a problem
facing.ex: The town is facing a water shortage.

far.ex: This book is far better than the film.

faster.ex: The new train runs faster than the old one.

firmly.ex: She firmly refused to sign the contract.
firmly.ja: きっぱりと；断固として

flagged.ex: The teacher flagged several mistakes in my essay.

following.ex: We left on Friday and arrived the following day.

for.en: on behalf of; showing purpose or time
for.zh: 為了；代表（a spokeswoman for：…的發言人）；（for some time：一段時間）

formal.en: official and done by the rules
formal.ex: You will receive a formal letter next week.

formally.ex: The new bridge was formally opened by the mayor.

forthright.ex: She is known for her forthright views on education.

found.ex: The inspectors found the kitchen very clean.

fraying.en: slowly becoming weaker or more tense
fraying.ex: Tempers began fraying after hours of waiting.
fraying.ja: ほころびかけて；悪化して

froze.en: stopped something from changing or going ahead
froze.ex: The company froze hiring until next year.

fully.ex: I fully agree with your idea.

further.ex: He further explained that the shop would close.

gave.en: handed or offered something to someone
gave.ex: My teacher gave me some useful advice.
gave.zh: 給予（gave her a warning：對她發出警告）

generating.ex: The new park is generating a lot of interest.
generating.ja: 引き起こして；生み出して

given.ex: She has given me her old bike.
given.zh: 給予（given him instructions：給他指示）

government.en: the group that runs a country
government.ex: The government plans to build more schools.

grave.ex: Pollution is a grave threat to wildlife.

growing.ex: The town's population is growing every year.

happy.ex: My parents were happy with my exam results.

has.en: helping verb for present perfect; owns
has.hi: (पूर्ण वर्तमान सहायक) है; के पास है

have.en: to take part in; helping verb
have.zh: 進行（have conversations）；（完成式助動詞）

head.ex: She is the head of the science department.
head.zh: 負責人；首長；（came to a head：達到頂點）

health.en: the state of the body; medical care
health.ex: Fresh food is good for your health.
health.zh: 衛生；健康（Health Minister：衛生部長）

health's.ex: The Minister for Health's plan was published today.
health's.zh: 衛生（部）的（Minister for Health's office：衛生部長辦公室）

heated.en: full of anger and strong feeling
heated.ex: The meeting ended after a heated debate.

held.ex: The concert was held in the town hall.

highlighted.ex: The report highlighted the need for more teachers.

hired.ex: The café hired three new waiters.

hiring.ex: The company stopped hiring during the crisis.

hold.en: to have or organise (a talk, meeting)
hold.ex: We will hold a meeting on Monday.
hold.zh: 進行；舉行（hold conversations：進行談話）

hospital.en: a place where sick people are treated
hospital.ex: He stayed in hospital for three days.

hospital's.ex: The hospital's car park is always full.

hospitals.en: places where sick people are treated
hospitals.ex: Both hospitals are near the city centre.

however.ex: The plan is good; however, it costs too much.

hse.hi: HSE: आयरलैंड की स्वास्थ्य सेवा संस्था
hse.ja: HSE：アイルランド保健サービス庁

immediate.ex: The fire needs an immediate response.

increasingly.ex: Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular.

incur.en: to have to pay or suffer something
incur.ex: You will incur a fee if you pay late.

example.en: The company incurred heavy losses last year.
example.zh: 該公司去年蒙受了巨大損失。

note.meaning: 招致；（因某事）承擔費用、損失或負債。
note.usage: 常見 incur costs/losses/a deficit/debt/a fine；多用於財務與正式語境。

noteEn.meaning: to have to pay or suffer something because of an action.
noteEn.usage: Common: "incur costs", "incur a deficit", "incur a fine".

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa sufrió grandes pérdidas el año pasado.
noteEs.meaning: tener que asumir un gasto, una pérdida o una deuda.
noteEs.usage: Se usa incur costs/losses/a deficit/a fine; contexto financiero.

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी को पिछले साल भारी नुकसान हुआ।
noteHi.meaning: किसी कारण ख़र्च, नुकसान या कर्ज़ उठाना।
noteHi.usage: incur costs/losses/a deficit/a fine आम हैं; वित्तीय संदर्भ में।

noteJa.exampleTr: その会社は昨年大きな損失を被った。
noteJa.meaning: 費用・損失・負債などを負う；被る。
noteJa.usage: incur costs/losses/a deficit/a fine の形が多い；財務の文脈で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 회사는 작년에 큰 손실을 입었다.
noteKo.usage: incur costs/losses/a deficit/a fine 형태가 흔하다; 재정 관련 문맥.

indicated.ex: He indicated that he might leave the company.

insists.en: says firmly that something is true
insists.ex: She insists that she paid the bill.
insists.ja: 主張している；言い張る

institution.en: a large organisation such as a hospital
institution.ex: The university is a respected institution.

instruct.en: to tell someone officially to do something
instruct.ex: The coach will instruct you on what to do.

instructed.ex: The workers were instructed to leave the building.

instructions.en: orders telling someone what to do
instructions.ex: Read the instructions before using the machine.

intensifying.ex: The storm is intensifying as it moves north.

internal.ex: The company is running an internal investigation.

is.zh: 是（be 的第三人稱單數）

paragraphs: Cork University Hospital is one of the biggest hospitals in Ireland. It has a big money problem. This year it will spend about €60 million more than its budget.
In August, the head of the hospital, Jennifer Kearney, wrote a letter. She said the hospital needed more staff. She said it was more than 1,000 workers short. The letter went to the newspapers.
Her bosses at the health service, the HSE, were not happy. They stopped about 700 new jobs to save money. At a meeting, a top HSE manager, Andy Philips, gave her a warning.
Notes from the meeting say the Taoiseach's office told him to talk to her. The Taoiseach and the Health Minister say this is not true.
The minister says the hospital is safe. Ms Kearney says things are getting worse.
sentZh: 科克大學醫院是愛爾蘭最大的醫院之一。
它有一個很大的錢的問題。
今年它的花費將比預算多出大約 6,000 萬歐元。
八月時，醫院的負責人珍妮佛・卡尼寫了一封信。
她說醫院需要更多員工。
她說醫院缺了超過 1,000 名員工。
這封信被送到了報社。
她在衛生服務署（HSE）的上司們很不高興。
他們為了省錢，暫停了大約 700 個新職缺。
在一場會議上，HSE 的一位高層主管安迪・菲利普斯對她提出了警告。
會議紀錄顯示，總理辦公室要他去找她談。
總理和衛生部長都說這不是事實。
部長說這家醫院是安全的。
卡尼女士則說情況正在變得更糟。

paragraphs: Cork University Hospital (CUH), one of the largest hospitals in Ireland, is in a serious argument with the health service about money and staff. The hospital expects to spend about €60 million more than its budget this year.

In August, the hospital's chief executive, Jennifer Kearney, wrote a letter to her managers in the HSE South West region. She said the number of patients was growing faster than the number of workers. Because of limits on hiring, she said, the hospital was more than 1,000 staff short. The letter was leaked to the media the next day.

Earlier that month, the head of HSE South West, Andy Philips, had stopped about 700 planned jobs while the region checked if it could pay for them. A senior doctor also warned that care for patients with diabetes was at serious risk.

Notes from a meeting on August 20th show an angry discussion between Mr Philips and Ms Kearney. According to the notes, he said the Taoiseach's office and the Minister for Health's office had told him to have some very direct conversations with her. He also warned that her performance could be formally reviewed.
Spokeswomen for Taoiseach Micheál Martin and Health Minister Jennifer Carroll MacNeill said neither of them had spoken to Mr Philips or given him instructions in August.

The minister says CUH has hired more staff than any similar hospital and that patient safety there is stable. However, Ms Kearney says she stands by her letter, and that the situation is getting worse.
sentZh: 科克大學醫院（CUH）是愛爾蘭最大的醫院之一，正與衛生服務體系為了經費和人手發生嚴重爭執。
醫院預計今年的支出將比預算多出約 6,000 萬歐元。
八月時，醫院執行長珍妮佛・卡尼寫信給她在 HSE 西南區的上級主管。
她說病人數量增加的速度比員工人數還快。
她表示，由於招聘受到限制，醫院缺了超過 1,000 名員工。
這封信隔天就被洩露給媒體。
同月稍早，HSE 西南區負責人安迪・菲利普斯暫停了約 700 個原定職缺，讓該區核查是否付得起這些薪水。
一位資深醫師也警告，糖尿病患者的照護正面臨嚴重風險。
8 月 20 日的會議紀錄顯示，菲利普斯先生和卡尼女士之間有一場激烈的爭論。
根據紀錄，他說總理辦公室和衛生部長辦公室要他和她進行一些非常直接的談話。
他還警告，她的工作表現可能會被正式審查。
總理米豪・馬丁與衛生部長珍妮佛・卡羅爾・麥克尼爾的發言人表示，兩人在八月都沒有和菲利普斯先生談過話，也沒有給他任何指示。
部長說，CUH 招聘的員工比其他同類醫院都多，而且那裡的病人安全狀況穩定。
然而，卡尼女士說她堅持信中的說法，並表示情況正在惡化。
